top: After his owner died at work in 1925, Hachiko kept waiting for him at Shibuya Station every single day for almost 10 years. In 2015, Japan finally gave them the reunion they never had.
comment: He waited 10 years for someone who was never coming back. We don't deserve dogs 🥺
